name: Dr Laura Connolly
title: Contact Psychologist
description: Dr Laura Connolly is a Clinical Neuropsychologist with a special interest in the assessment and diagnosis of adult ADHD, Autism, brain injury and dementia. She has a passion for working collaboratively with patients aged 16 and older, taking a strengths-based approach to helping individuals reach their goals. She regularly conducts assessment of a wide range of conditions, including various forms of acquired/traumatic brain injury, dementia, neurological/ neurodevelopmental conditions, and psychological disorders.

name: Haris Constantinou
title: Psychologist
description: Harry (Haris) is a psychologist and psychoanalyst who has been working in community health, specialist mental health and private practice for 25 years. He has treated people in many varied fields of practice including in the addiction fields, complex traumas, and with identity issues.
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Sexual difficulties, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)

name: Dr Angela Khor
title: Psychologist
description: *ACCEPTING NEW CLIENTS* Angela is a senior clinical psychologist with over 10 years of experience working in the public system and private practice. She provides assessment and treatment for young people and adults struggling with issues such as depression, anxiety, eating difficulties, stress, adjusting to life changes, self-esteem, trauma, and navigating relationships (including friendships, romantic relationships, and parent-child relationships). She is trained in Cognitive Behaviour Therapy (CBT), Cognitive Analytic Therapy (CAT), Family Based Treatment (FBT), and Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR).
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), EMDR

name: Chelsea Bloom
title: Contact Psychologist
description: Chelsea works with people who are motivated to make meaningful change in their lives. Many of her clients come seeking to change how they feel or live - whether that's addressing longstanding emotional patterns, unhelpful behaviours, trouble in relationships, or experiencing a life that looks – on track – but doesn’t feel that way inside. She draws on Emotion Focussed Therapy, Schema Therapy, EMDR, and Coaching Psychology to meet each client’s unique needs and goals. She also offers CBT-Extended and Interpersonal Psychotherapy for individuals dealing with eating disorders and eating-related concerns Chelsea is an ally for the LGBTQIA+ community [email protected]
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, EMDR, Schema Therapy

name: Dr Dominic Doyle
title: Psychologist
description: Dr Dominic Doyle is a clinical psychologist and psychotherapist. Dominic has worked across a variety of mental health settings over many years. Dominic works with those experiencing emotional difficulty, including anxiety, depression, trauma, anger, relationship problems, parenting issues, grief and the broader psychological challenges associated with adjusting to a change in roles and stage of life.

name: Samantha Fredericks
title: Psychologist
description: Samantha Fredericks is a registered psychologist with an MBA and diverse experience in clinical and business environments. She is kind and compassionate, tailoring strategies for her clients so they feel heard, supported and empowered to create meaningful change, enhance their relationships, and achieve their goals. Samantha works one-on-one with adults with anxiety and panic disorders, depression, overwhelm, neurodiversity, trauma, PTSD and complex presentations.
specialties: Dissociative Identity Disorder, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse sexualities, Schema Therapy, EMDR

name: Dr Veronica Coady
title: Psychologist
description: Veronica is a registered psychologist, and works across the lifespan. She is available for Telehealth appointments, Australia Wide, and face to face appointments in the North West suburbs of Melbourne, Victoria.
specialties: Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse sexualities

name: Gilchrist Clendinnen
title: Psychologist
description: I like helping clients with ADHD, anxiety depression, addiction (Both substances and behaviours like gambling and porn) and trauma. I help clients develop a better understanding of the changes they would like to make, and a plan for how to make them.
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Sexual difficulties, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)
